description: This file contains the PHP class 'GeoZone' in the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. It implements various methods for managing geographic zones, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving geo zones and their related zones and zones counts within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class interacts with database tables such as 'geo_zone', 'zone_to_geo_zone', and implements caching and data retrieval functions.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Represents a geographic zone management model, providing CRUD operations for geo zones and associated zones within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Inserts a new geo zone record into the database and optionally adds associated zones. Clears cache after operation.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geo zone record and its associated zones. Clears cache after operation.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes a geo zone record and its associated zones. Clears cache after operation.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific geo zone by its ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo zones with optional sorting and pagination, using cache for optimization.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geo zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Associates a zone with a geo zone by inserting a record into 'zone_to_geo_zone'.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Deletes all zone associations for a given geo zone.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches all zones associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts zones associated with a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts zones associated with a specific zone ID.
